title: Stage-gate weekly check-in notes
content:
Purpose: quick prep notes for the Stage-Gate weekly check-in (T-minus 7 days). Personal scratchpad — action owners + gate flags i need to review 1:1 before the sync.

High-level objective
- Confirm go/no-go readiness across infra, runtime, console, and docs.
- Surface any last-minute risk that needs a blocker call.

Attendees I plan to ping before the meeting
- Priya (release manager) - confirm rollout windows and canary config
- Carlos (SRE) - capacity + failover verification
- Liam (serving runtime lead) - KV cache warmup status, kernel compatibility checks
- Security on standby (TBD) - KMS rotations done?

Pre-checks (things to validate in 1:1s or quick checks)
- Infra: dedicated-capacity pools provisioned? (ENG-7821) -> Carlos to confirm by 2026-03-10.
- Network: allowed IPs + egress rules for private deploy demo -> Priya to confirm.
- Runtime: latest build (sha: b3f9a2) deployed to canary nodes; smoke script passes < 2s P95 -> Liam.
- Console: rollout toggles + rollback toggle present -> Me (Maya) to verify UI state.
- Billing/Quotas: soft limits increased for org account -> Ops billing ticket REL-314.
- Docs: runbook updated? quick link in Confluence page -> if not, add TODO.

Checklist (owner / status / notes)
- Canary deploy smoke test: Liam / in_progress / failing on long cold-start for encoder path. action: try smaller batch size in canary config (deadline 2026-03-11).
- KV cache prewarm script: Carlos / blocked / needs credentials to private bucket. action: Priya to provide bucket ACLs (due 2026-03-09).
- Metrics dashboards: Maya / ready / add token-level cost chart to top row.
- Rollback playbook: Maya / draft / add step to switch DNS to fallback region + preserve traces (need SRE runbook id).
- Customer comms draft: Priya / in_review / two small wording edits; push to final by 2026-03-12.
- Postmortem template hooked to incident pipeline: Liam / done / verify fields map to observability events.

Quick risk register (my shorthand)
- R1: Cold-start spike in canary -> impact: high latency for first wave -> mitigation: reduce batch size + warmup pods, extend canary window. Owner: Liam.
- R2: Missing bucket ACLs -> impact: failure to prewarm -> mitigation: SRE manual warmup + escalate to infra. Owner: Carlos / Priya.
- R3: KMS rotation during rollout -> impact: encrypted models inaccessible -> mitigation: freeze rotation window for rollout; have KMS rollback plan. Owner: Security (TBD).
- R4: Cost anomaly -> impact: budget overshoot -> mitigation: throttling + quick A/B fallback to smaller model. Owner: Maya / Billing.

Rollback triggers (explicit, so we can call go->no-go quickly)
- >3x expected 95th latency sustained for >5 minutes across canary -> partial rollback/stop rollout.
- Error rate for generation calls >1% for 10 minutes -> stop and fallback.
- KV cache miss rate >60% leading to CPU spike -> halt and investigate.

Open questions to ask in meeting
- Do we have final confirmation from security about KMS freeze window? (put on agenda)
- Can the billing team pre-authorize temporary quota bump for burst traffic?
- Are there any outstanding PRs that change model tokenizer or IO shape? (scan PR list before meeting)

My personal prep checklist (things i'll say or check)
- Start with current sprint health: 2 green, 1 yellow (canary cold-start).
- Flag the cold-start as the only technical blocker and propose mitigations (batch size + warmup).
- Request explicit sso confirmation from security to avoid last-minute hold.
- Confirm rollback owners (SRE lead + runtime lead + me). Add fallback chain in runway doc.

Follow-ups and owners (short)
- Liam: implement reduced batch config in canary + update smoke script (due 2026-03-11).
- Carlos: escalate bucket ACLs + give ETA for manual warmup (due 2026-03-09).
- Priya: finalize customer comms and confirm windows in calendar (due 2026-03-12).
- Maya: update runbook with explicit rollback triggers and dashboard link (due 2026-03-12).

Notes to self (scratchy)
- If security says no to KMS freeze, prepare airgap test plan and a rollback to model artifact signed with old key.
- Remember to reference REL-314 and ENG-7821 during the sync.
- Keep the meeting tight: 25 min, focused on gates + blockages; use parking lot for ancillary topics.

Mini agenda (25 min)
- 0-5m: quick status (owners report green/yellow/red)
- 5-12m: active blockers + mitigation decisions (cold-start + ACLs)
- 12-18m: confirm rollout window, canary config, and smoke criteria
- 18-23m: explicit go/no-go polling and assignment of final tasks
- 23-25m: confirm communications (customer + internal) and next check-in time

Post-meeting deliverables I will produce (for my notes)
- One-paragraph decision note in the release channel (include explicit go/no-go and the triggers).
- Update runbook with any new rollback steps and owners.
- Create a follow-up ticket for post-launch quality review (assign to product ops).

Random quick links to check before meeting
- Smoke script: github: serving-runtime/ops/smoke/scripts/warmup.sh
- Canary PR: github: /pull/4212 (see linked_artifacts)
- Runbook: confluence: /display/RELEASE/Runbooks

End of scratchpad.

-- maya
